fusions.name: Flung Catch
fusions.desc: Hurls a slippery catch that deals 7 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hauled Ashore
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Drumming Challenge
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. An escort of water fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip and Grip
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all for 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
